title: Dollar-Math Normalization at Render Time
description: The content module shall normalize dollar-delimited math to AsciiDoc STEM notation in all export paths at render time.
rationale: Stored sections contain dollar-delimited math written before the STEM convention was adopted. Destructively rewriting stored content has no safe rollback path; render-time normalization is idempotent and preserves stored content as the authoritative source of truth.
